The main takeaway from our work is that
there are no clear‐cut prognostic factors that predict outcome in adults with ALL.

the treatment of adults with ALL is a complex and multifactorial process that requires a careful selection of the appropriate treatment regimen based on the patient’s age, comorbidities, cytogenetic/molecular profile, and response to induction therapy.
